name: Storm
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 5th; Slot bracers/arm; Price 36,000 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

This tattoo is most often rendered with the image of a storm cloud and lightning on one arm and shoulder.

The tattoo’s owner gains the following:

Continual: electricity resistance 10
3/day: lightning bolt (5d6 damage, Reflex DC 16).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Tattoo, lightning bolt, resist energy; Cost 18,000 gp.
